scope.method: Copied frozen engine database/WAL into private temporary directories, opened SDK only there, normalized run1 with explicit state compression/compaction and compacted run2 copy for fragmentation measurement. Original runtime and frozen files unchanged; no browser/provider or plugin database access.

gzipEstimates.note: Byte-only gzip3 estimate on existing plain rows with a hypothetical fixed 300-byte envelope; no database encoding was changed. Threshold groups overlap and must not be added together. No write/read CPU estimate.

caveats: Field-level byte counts describe exact serialized top-level values before compression and overlap nested content; they are not directly additive physical-saving estimates. Exact duplicates may still be semantically distinct records and cannot be deleted without preserving IDs/ownership/links.
Per-event gzip3 byte estimates exclude envelopes/schema migration/index costs; they are a possible codec investigation, not an implemented storage change or speed claim.

Restart loses only in-memory admission hints/caches. Persistent object hashes remain session-scoped and independently verifiable; controls can legitimately receive new document/instance IDs after navigation.
Compaction is applied only to disposable copies to measure free-page/packing effects; no retention or logical root deletion occurs.
